title: Register defects found in this migration

source_section.heading: ## F. Register defects found in this migration

next_exact_action: Reported, not repaired — the export is kept faithful. See `registers/KNOWN_FINDINGS.json`.
inputs_note: engine/carriers/MANIFEST.json did not exist when this lane file was written (engine/carriers/ is owned elsewhere in this repository), so no carrier_id is bound here. tools/lanes_check.py validates every id in `inputs` against that manifest as soon as the manifest exists.

not_a_substitute.quote: OP-CNS-001 §2 requires collisions to be preserved and disambiguated in an append-only collision registry.
Three Quarantine Index rows use class `EXISTING_CONTAINER`, which OP-PROT-019 §6 does not define. Proposal: add `CONTAINER_POINTER` to the table.
not_a_substitute.reading: A proposal is a proposal; no register class is added or changed here.

repo_state_note: `registers/KNOWN_FINDINGS.json` records the defects, `registers/collision_proposal.json` and `registers/COLLISION_PROPOSAL.md` carry a proposed append-only disambiguation, and `tools/collision_proposal_check.py` keeps the proposal honest against the export. Nothing under `registers/source/`, `registers/json/` or `registers/csv/` is edited: that is exported source data and CI fails if it drifts, so the repair belongs at the source, not here. `repo_state` describes only what code exists in this repository. It is not a mathematical status and no verdict, promotion or discharge may be read from it.
does_not_establish: This lane repairs no register, resolves no duplicate identifier, adds no quarantine class, and does not decide which row of a colliding pair is correct. A proposal carries no authority.
status_absent_reason: docs/OPEN_PROBLEMS.md §F reports defects and assigns the section no status label. Its own words are 'Reported, not repaired'. No status is invented here.
blocks_note: Empty by transcription: these are register-integrity defects and the section names no claim or premise in claims/graph.json that they block.
